en.sarwar: 5. Sahl has narrated from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamdani who has said the following. “I wrote to the man (Imam abu al-Hassan the 3rd (a.s.) explaining, “Your followers in this city differ on the issue of the Oneness of Allah. Some of them say that Allah has a body, and others say that Allah has a form.”
The Imam replied in his own handwriting, “Glory belongs to Allah, Who can not be defined nor described. There is nothing similar to Him. He is All-hearing, All-knowing, or the Imam said All-seeing.”
en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Hamdany who said, ‘I wrote to the manasws that the ones before us from the ones in yourasws Wilayah are differing regarding the Tawheed. So, from them is one who is saying, ‘A body’, and from them is one who is saying, ‘An Image’’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote in his<sup>asws</sup> own handwriting: ‘Glorious is the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who cannot be limited, nor can He<sup>azwj</sup> be described. There is nothing like Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the Hearing, the All-Knowing’. Or he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘All-Seeing’’.
